strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Product completion decisions now derive technical-debt state from prior runtime provenance plus explicit bounded transitions, so autonomous continuation cannot forget open debt by omission.
Rust validates debt classification/status semantics, closure evidence fingerprints, transition conflicts, and product_complete denial before ledger mutation.
Only bounded debt metadata, classifications, statuses, action hints, and SHA-256 fingerprints are persisted or returned; raw prompts, responses, files, diffs, commands, and paths remain excluded.
Existing decision and continuation provenance expose derived active debt state and fingerprints without adding a separate report surface.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, context_management, and progress_visualization.
answers.new_capability: Rust derives next technical-debt state from previous runtime provenance plus explicit bounded new/resolve/supersede/defer transitions instead of trusting a caller-supplied full replacement list.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M54.1 fingerprints caller-supplied carry-forward items but cannot detect omitted prior debt, and status/next_action are bounded strings without completion-blocking semantics.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Known unresolved debt can silently disappear across continuation and product_complete can be claimed while blocking or required-before-release debt remains open/deferred.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M53.1.1 request binding, M53.2 task.run freshness, and M54.1 carry-forward admission because M54.2 derives and enforces debt state transitions.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends existing product completion decision and product-continuation provenance shapes only.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or standalone registry surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust reads previous debt state, validates explicit transitions, derives the next state, denies product_complete while release-blocking debt remains active, binds replay to the derived fingerprint, and carries active debt into continuation provenance.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can safely continue or stop development using replay-safe debt state rather than external review-memory prose.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the semantic authority gap left by M54.1 and makes M54 closeout-assessable if review accepts the implementation.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M54.2 updates current and archived manifests for a runtime-owned technical-debt state transition gate. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and no report-only registry/readiness surface was added.

exit_criteria: Product completion decision derives next technical-debt state from prior product-continuation provenance plus explicit bounded new debt and transition inputs
Prior open/deferred debt cannot disappear by omission
Rust validates classification values blocking|required_before_release|post_v0 and active statuses open|deferred
Resolved and superseded transitions require closure_evidence_fingerprint
Product-complete decisions are denied while blocking or required-before-release debt remains open/deferred
Post-v0 debt may remain visible without blocking product_complete
Continue_development decisions carry the derived open/deferred debt state into ProductContinuationProvenance
Replay identity includes the derived technical-debt state fingerprint and conflicting transitions fail closed
VSIX protocol validation accepts bounded state-transition shapes and rejects malformed/raw debt payloads
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_records_product_complete_decision rejects product_complete with active blocking debt and accepts product_complete without release-blocking debt.
Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_records_product_completion_decision_and_replays validates bounded debt classification/status/fingerprint behavior, replay stability, and conflicting debt denial.
Rust behavior test task_start_admits_product_continuation_and_replays_without_running validates derived active debt is preserved in ProductContinuationProvenance.
VSIX protocol tests validate accepted and rejected technical_debt_carry_forward and technical_debt_transitions payloads.

safety_boundary: No new JSON-RPC method or standalone debt report/registry/readiness surface
Debt state is derived by Rust from previous runtime provenance plus bounded explicit transitions
Duplicate, malformed, non-ASCII, oversized, raw-looking, unknown, conflicting, or evidence-less closing transitions fail before ledger mutation

Replay identity includes the derived debt-state fingerprint
No provider, verifier, apply, shell, git, network, service, automatic run, or workspace mutation capability is added
non_goals: No caller-owned full replacement debt list as the source of truth
No automatic planning, scheduling, task run, provider call, verification, proposal apply, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation

A planning-review prose wrapper was rejected because M54.2 must change Rust runtime decision semantics.
